readiness_reason: Break and Steal an Egg (SRC-017) and steal_egg (SRC-018) both have OBSERVED live economy + content data of equivalent depth. The §14 gate (>=2 games at equivalent depth) is therefore arguably met for a TWO-way comparison — but ride_a_pet still has only third-party material, and the gate's intent was originally a 3-way study. Awaiting explicit user decision before generating update ideas; until then update_opportunities.json stays empty.

comparisons.break_steal_egg: Break egg (HP) → escape guards → deposit animal at base → cash → upgrade speed/pickaxe → deeper biomes
comparisons.steal_egg: OBSERVED (SRC-018): steal egg (world pets via proximity + players via bat fling) → grow egg in real time (10s→18h) → hatch → place pet at base for money/s → upgrade base (12 levels) + treadmill (12 tiers) → rarer areas (13 areas) + size/mutation chase
comparisons.ride_a_pet: Find egg on map → hatch → ride pet (speed) → mutate for speed → reach rarer eggs
comparisons.same: All three: acquire egg → hatch → pet → speed is the progression stat → chase rarer content. Collection/Index meta present in at least two.
comparisons.different: Acquisition verb differs: MINE (pickaxe) vs. THEFT (players/pets) vs. SCAVENGE (map search). Speed source differs: trained stat (BSE, SAE) vs. pet stat (RAP). Banking step differs: deposit at base (BSE) vs. place-and-earn passive income (SAE) vs. ride directly (RAP).
missing_data: live witnessing of SAE theft flow

comparisons.break_steal_egg: OBSERVED: NPC guardians (CatchDistance 2, OutrunSpeedFactor 0.85, fling 12-115) + player theft + zone bats for knockback; failure state partially known (fling/ragdoll 3s, animal drop per guide)
comparisons.steal_egg: OBSERVED (SRC-018): THREE stacked risk layers like BSE — area guardians (WalkSpeed 16→251, ragdoll 2.5s, retrieve/deposit eggs), player bats (fling), plus explicit counter-play the player can place (freeze traps 7s, gravity slow, control-inverting bees). Carry penalty slows you up to 33% while holding eggs — quantified risk knob.
comparisons.ride_a_pet: Possible egg timer / spawn competition; no theft or NPC threat observed
comparisons.same: All create a retrieval challenge between acquiring and banking a reward.
comparisons.different: Risk source: NPC (BSE) vs. NPC+players+carry-weight (SAE) vs. time/competition (RAP, unconfirmed). SAE is now the only one with QUANTIFIED escape penalties (carry slowdown 15–33%) and player-placed counter-play.
missing_data: whether RAP egg timer really exists

comparisons.break_steal_egg: OBSERVED: SpeedPower gates zones (5 -> 1e11), 20 pickaxe tiers (0 -> 7.5e16 cash), 9 plot levels, 6 satchels, treadmill (two CONFLICTING tables: 6 tiers vs 9 levels)
comparisons.steal_egg: OBSERVED (SRC-018): base 12 levels (1,000 → 5e15 cash, capacity 7→19), treadmill 12 tiers (0 → 7.5e15 cash, x2 → x8,500 multiplier), speed XP curve (1.15 growth, +2/level, base 10 → ref max 400), index completion unlocks bats + speed rewards
comparisons.ride_a_pet: Pet speed via rarity + mutation rerolls; possible rebirth multipliers (unconfirmed)
comparisons.same: Speed-centric progression in all three; cash sinks in all three.
comparisons.different: RAP invests in PETS as the speed vehicle; the other two invest in the PLAYER's stat and tool. Both BSE and SAE split progression into multiple independent cash sinks (BSE: 4 sinks + separate speed currency; SAE: base + treadmill + index, with Speed trained separately from Money).

comparisons.steal_egg: OBSERVED (SRC-018): 18 rarity entries (ranks 1–12), 11 weighted size scale bands (0.1x–35x), 11 mutation variants, per-area indexes that unlock bats
comparisons.ride_a_pet: Index/collection panel observed in video; 24 rarity tiers listed by IGN
comparisons.same: All three are collection games at heart.
comparisons.different: Variant depth: SAE has explicit size (11 bands) + mutation (11 variants) axes now OBSERVED; RAP has mutation; BSE has mutation (5) but size is UNKNOWN, not absent.
missing_data: complete pet/egg lists for all three

comparisons.break_steal_egg: OBSERVED: theft of carried animals (guide/video) + zone-gated BAT weapons with knockback/ragdoll (BatConfig, remotes) + global boosts, friend boosts, leaderboards
comparisons.steal_egg: OBSERVED: theft (bats fling players to steal eggs), 13 bats, traps/freeze (7s), GravityDisruptor (50%), BeeLauncher (invert controls 5s); guards retrieve/deposit eggs; area guardians exist.
comparisons.ride_a_pet: Shared 6-player servers; no player-interaction verb observed
comparisons.same: All three run in shared servers.
comparisons.different: BSE has zone-gated bat combat + theft. SAE has bat-based theft AND a richer defensive counter-play kit (traps/gravity/bees) AND area guardians that retrieve/deposit — it's much closer to BSE on the 'theft arms race' than previously assumed. RAP appears more parallel/co-op.
missing_data: confirmed absence of any PvP in RAP
live PvP observation in BSE (witnessed config + existence)
live theft flow observation in SAE

comparisons.break_steal_egg: OBSERVED inventory: 3 permanent Robux upgrades (x2 Cash / x2 Swing / x2 Growth), 6 speed packs, 5 cash packs, 6 potions, fallen egg/token packs, ~28 timer-skip products, a DevProductId on every pickaxe tier. Robux PRICES not captured.
comparisons.steal_egg: OBSERVED (SRC-018): 3 gamepasses (x2 Money, x2 Growth, Lucky) + 127 product entries: money packs, +1M speed, treadmill-speed time offers, permanent/temporary speed boosts, SERVER-WIDE paid luck x4/x8, 9 Instant Hatch tiers (15min–10h), all 12 treadmills, trails, limited-egg packs, rewarded-video ads. Robux prices not captured.
comparisons.same: All three presumably monetize; BSE and SAE now have verified inventories.
comparisons.different: BSE monetizes time skips + stats + per-pickaxe-tier products. SAE monetizes more broadly still: egg-growth time (Instant Hatch), SERVER-WIDE luck (social monetization), and rewarded-video ads (ad-monetization hybrid) — structurally the widest monetization surface observed so far.

comparisons.steal_egg: OBSERVED (SRC-018): a seasonal event (Halloween Dimension) was LIVE at capture time; 20+ event/mode systems exist as modules — indicates active live-ops

comparisons.same: At least SAE and RAP show live-ops evidence (seasonal events); BSE not yet captured.
comparisons.different: SAE's live-ops is broad (20+ event systems, seasonal dimension); RAP shows a seasonal event title only.
